scope: Narrow cosmic-ray theory domain: the secondary antiproton source term q(T_pbar) = sum_ij 4 pi n_j int phi_i dsigma_ij/dT dT_i for the channels pp, pHe, Hep and HeHe, with the antineutron and hyperon factor (2 + Delta_IS + 2 Delta_Lambda) and alternative cross-section sets as model alternatives, following the conventions of the hep-theory cosmic-ray reference. The shipped cross sections are a TOY x-scaling form with ILLUSTRATIVE values, chosen because the source integral then has a closed form (incomplete beta functions) that benchmarks the profile's numerical integration; an external benchmark (B2) reproduces the pp source term of Table VI of di Mauro et al. 2014 with that paper's own closed-form parametrizations, which are used for the benchmark only. model.family is a source term, not a propagation family.
exclusions: Published antiproton cross-section parametrizations as nominal inputs (the di Mauro et al. 2014 pp forms serve the external benchmark only) and fitted nuclear rescaling functions; energy-dependent Delta_IS or Lambda-bar/pbar
Projectiles or targets heavier than helium; tertiary antiprotons; nuclear threshold lowering
Propagation of the source term, solar modulation, and any comparison with measured antiproton fluxes
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field; no external program run

Claims that the illustrative values describe the Galaxy; published source terms beyond the pp channel of di Mauro et al. 2014 Table VI (the spline, Tan & Ng and Duperray et al. columns and three entries are documented, not reproduced)

capabilities.name: source-term-derivation
capabilities.scope: SymPy checks that the source integral for a power-law primary and the toy x-scaling cross section is an incomplete beta function (above and below threshold, broken power laws by pieces) and of the antineutron/hyperon bookkeeping (analytic derivation for the toy form, not formal proof)

capabilities.name: source-term-benchmark
capabilities.scope: internal benchmark: the profile's numerical quadrature against the closed form for four channels, power-law and broken power-law primaries, energies on both sides of the threshold (1e-8), and a hand-computed point (1e-10)

capabilities.name: source-term-external-benchmark
capabilities.scope: external benchmark (B2): the pp source term of di Mauro et al., PRD 90 (2014) 085017, Table VI, recomputed from the same paper's closed forms Eqs. (11)-(13), (B1)-(B2) and its proton flux input; 12 of 15 entries within the paper's own 1-sigma errors (within 2.5% at 5 and 10 GeV), the other 3 and the non-closed-form columns documented, not reproduced (E2, 2026-10-15)

capabilities.name: source-term-prediction
capabilities.scope: q(T_pbar) per channel and in total, channel fractions, antineutron and hyperon switches, bin-averaged prediction artifact with a cross-section set and an antineutron treatment as model alternatives; theory-spec and prediction validate, and the theory-spec needs no degenerate_directions (source-term family)
